Two boards that disagree cannot settle a chrome-ui-wide primitive — do not change BK_TEXT_INPUT_THEME off one screen board. 2026-08-17 board 202:2 set authority=code:expand-not-pin: its whole subject is a drawer PIN that a founder decision retired (commit 1c8f759d — board 16:6 draws corner brackets, not a pin, and the founder confirmed expand; isPinned/onPinToggle became isExpanded/onExpandToggle across 30 files). Its toast, 'Widen past 1380 to pin it again', names a control that no longer exists, and the shipped shell already floats a panel at narrow widths — the INSPECTOR, at max-width:1366px in LayoutShell.css. Walked live at 1280 anyway, which found the real defect the board's own layout avoids: the canvas footer toolbar scrolled X-Ray and the shortcuts button out of sight. Fixed by wrapping the bar. 2026-08-17 board 65:2 walked: everything on it matches live except the drawer, which the board draws CLOSED on first run while the shell opens Insert (useStudioState.ts:234 — 'Always open on session start', an incident fix after persisting closed stranded users with an invisible panel). Left open deliberately, marked authority=open:first-run-drawer: the same board answers 'where did everything go?' with a rail coach mark ('Everything you build lives behind these six' · Got it) that belongs to the S1 flows family (297:1972, 807:4299, 807:6558) and is not built. Closing the drawer without the coach mark ships half the design and is worse than either half. The two land together. 2026-08-17 board 66:4 walked. Its inspector, status bar ('3 elements selected' + dimensions) and layers drawer all match live. Its ANNOTATION does not: 'Per-element properties are hidden while more than one thing is selected — editing them would silently apply to all three' is contradicted by board 159:123 (Inspector · multi-select), read directly, which draws Background / Text colour / Radius / Padding / Font size with 'Mixed' placeholders and the line 'Editing a Mixed field applies it to all three.' — i.e. the properties ARE shown, and nothing about it is silent. The code follows 159:123 (BatchStylePanel), so authority=board:159-123 for that annotation. Two things NOT changed and why: (1) the canvas keeps its floating count badge and alignment toolbar — 66:4 draws neither, but it also draws only ONE selection ring for a 3-element selection, so its canvas art is the single-select frame reused and is not evidence; (2) 159:123 spells the row 'Text colour' while board 807:8342 spells the same control 'Color' and so does every other colour row in the inspector — the boards disagree with each other, the inspector is internally consistent, so the code keeps 'Text color'. 2026-08-17 board 200:213 built: its review bar (open count · Next › · Compare · Re-send) did not exist — the only review chrome in the shell was the topbar pill, which says a review EXISTS and nothing about working through it. Live-verified against a seeded PENDING round with agency_layer on for the test workspace (both reverted after). ONE delta left, authority=open:pill-count: the board's pill reads 'In review · 3 open' and the shipped pill reads 'In review'. Adding the count means `reviews.status` returning it — a tRPC + shared-schema change that belongs to the Review panel family's own walk, not to a Shell-states board; the count is on screen directly below the pill meanwhile. 2026-08-17 board 66:225 walked, no change needed. Its placement claim is already true — 'Ask AI' swaps the RIGHT panel to the AI surface with a '‹ Inspector' back chevron and a tinted Scope strip, measured live at l=1140 w=300. Its RUN state is superseded by the AI family's own board 170:70, read directly: 'RUNNING · 2 OF 3' over numbered step rows with a Stop under them, which is what AgentPlan implements — not 66:225's 'Still working on: Hero' card with bullets. Shell thumbnail loses to the family board, same as 66:4 vs 159:123. 2026-08-17 board 66:640 walked and left alone, founder gate confirmed on the evidence rather than inherited from the plan doc. The board offers two ways out — 'Review both' and 'Keep mine' — where the shipped ConflictModal offers three: Reload latest, Save a backup, Overwrite. Conforming literally would DELETE two data-safety exits in exchange for a compare surface that does not exist. Its copy ('Sara saved a change to this page 40 seconds ago') also names the other writer and the elapsed time, and nothing in the conflict path carries either — the modal's props are four callbacks. So even the copy cannot be adopted honestly until the save path returns who and when. 2026-08-17 Review panel family walked live against a seeded round (3 rounds, 12 comments, agency_layer on for the test workspace). Conform as drawn: 156:2 open, 157:58 all-resolved, 157:221 empty, 158:2 re-send-confirm, 158:105 revoke-confirm, 157:2 detached (after this walk filled its band). Three rows re-marked. 157:169 older-round is authority=blocked:no-round-linkage: the `Comment` model carries siteId/pageId and NO reviewRequestId or roundId at all (prisma/schema.prisma:471), so an older round's comments cannot be fetched — the panel's missing ‹ › arrows are a data-model gap, not a missing endpoint, and ReviewTab already says so inline. 158:213 review-closed is authority=open:panel-absence: it is a frame that documents an ABSENCE ('the panel and the 7th rail icon both disappear'), half of which is already moot — the shipped rail has no Review icon — and removing the panel on approval would take Compare and the resolved history with it, with no other door. 158:162 revoked is authority=code:keeps-open-group: the board hides the OPEN group while its own counter reads '9 of 12' and its copy promises 'earlier comments are kept below', so the frame contradicts itself; the panel keeps both groups. Every board's foot draws Compare + one primary only, and the shipped foot adds a reply composer and 'Revoke link' — no board draws a revoke ENTRY anywhere, though 158:105 boards its confirm, so the entry has to live somewhere and the foot is where it is. 2026-08-17 Templates family started. 782:4402 no-results matches live exactly ('Nothing matches ‘q’.' + Clear search + Browse all). 1138:13413 empty carries the board's copy verbatim in DrawerGallery. 642:2556 preview matches in shape, and the one copy defect it exposed is fixed here: the consequence line interpolated the page name in front of the word 'page', which reads only for noun-named pages ('the current Home page content') and breaks on the default every new site has ('the current Page 1 page content'). 641:2487 gallery is authority=open:no-section-catalog: the board draws a SECTION TEMPLATES group under the page cards, DrawerGallery implements it (pageCount == null → section), and the catalog has 10 entries of which 10 carry pageCount — so the group is code-complete with nothing to show. Authoring section templates is content, not code. (The board's 'updated 12 Jun' fact line stays unbuilt for the reason TemplateApplyModal already states: the catalog has no date and a made-up one is worse than a missing one.) 2026-08-17 board 1169:4753 save-as-template: it was the ONE Templates board no file cited. The modal exists and is reachable (canvas command palette), but drew three fields where the board draws one, and omitted the board's hint — 'Tokens are snapshotted — applying it later re-maps them to that site's brand' — because the hint was not TRUE. The apply half of that round trip was wired (TemplatesTab runs resolveTokens against a live snapshot); the save half was not: inverseResolveTokens was written, tested and imported by nothing, so a saved template carried this project's literal hexes and applying it into another site painted that site in these colours. Save now runs it against the same snapshot source, so the hint is printed because it holds. The Category select is gone: getUserTemplates parses the stored row as {id,name,description,html} and hardcodes category:'my-templates', so the user chose from six options nothing read. Description stays despite the board's single field — unlike category it IS read, by the drawer's search and TemplateDetail. 1169:4713 replace-confirm and the other four remaining rows are cited in code with tests. 778:4102 loading is authority=blocked:static-catalog: the board draws a full skeleton — three placeholder page cards and three section rows — but the built-in catalog is a static module array that is already on screen when the only fetch (the user's saved templates) starts, so a skeleton over it would state that the visible cards are still loading. 781:4372's load-error IS built, in DrawerGallery, because that pull can genuinely fail; TemplateDetail's comment claimed both were unbuilt and was stale on the error half. 2026-08-18 AI family started with a live BEHAVIOUR walk (boards unavailable, Figma MCP down). 170:2 idle and 170:17 scoped verified live: the panel opens in the RIGHT slot with a '‹ Inspector' chevron and the scope band reads 'Scope: Whole page' / 'Scope: heading' off the real selection. Driving a real prompt found a defect no board could show: tRPC 11 lists INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR in retryableRpcCodes, so a provider failure never reached onError — the SSE stream reopened forever (measured: 1 EventSource, 5 opens, 5 errors, 0 data) and the panel sat on 'Thinking…'. Only PRECONDITION_FAILED (171:136) and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS (171:105) could ever surface, which is exactly why those are the only two error states drawn. Both are genuinely reachable now (authority=code:reachable-now) and a third state carries everything else.,1 board appended 2026-08-24: a from-code capture of the shipped SEO panel, parked beside 302:1978. That board predates the score block, checks grid and banner entirely — it draws four plain fields — so it cannot adjudicate their visuals. The capture is reference, not a target: status out-of-scope, authority code:capture. 2026-09-01 FIELD SPLIT: `authority` was being used for two different jobs — which artefact wins a conflict (its documented meaning) AND whether anyone had checked the screen. One column held `walked:match`, `walked:drift-...` and `walked:unreachable-...` as if they were the same statement, so "281 walked" read as coverage when only 50 of those rows asserted a clean pass. `verified` now carries the check (no | driven | match | drift-open | drift-fixed | unreachable) with the detail in `verifiedNote`; `authority` is back to board|code|founder|blocked|open|superseded|undecided. Founder decision D1, /autoplan 2026-09-01.
